segments.text: Big Google Monkey builds shiny blue AI box.
Call it Gemini.
Google monkey say, Gemini best AI in jungle.
Beat chat GPT on paper benchmarks.
Beat Claude on context window size.
But when monkey coders use Gemini in real jungle,
monkey cry, Gemini lose again.
Why Google AI with $2 trillion jungle money
keep losing to small purple AI monkey Claude?
Let monkey explain real computer science.
Reason one is Moe expert routing versus dense attention.
Gemini use mixture of experts architecture.
Gemini is like a huge jungle office
with many specialist monkeys.
Monkey desk A no Python code.
Monkey desk B no English grammar.
Monkey desk C no safety rules.
When you ask big coding question,
router monkey send your request across different desks
but router monkey sometimes send code task to wrong desk.
If routing missed the optimal path,
Gemini give shallow answer or forget half of your instruction.
Computer monkeys call this expert routing breakdown
while Claude use dense transformer attention.
Every single neuron processor code together
at the exact same time.
Reason two is post training alignment and reward models.
Google train Gemini with RLHF for fast search engine answers.
Gemini want answer quick, so user click more links.
Anthropic train.
Claude with constitutional AI
and direct preference optimization.
Claude train to be quiet, thoughtful coding monkey.
Claude think step by step before touching any banana.
So when coding project get complex,
Gemini get lazy, skip middle line to code,
write comment to do insert code here, monkey furious,
while Claude write full clean code without lazy shortcut.
Reason three is needle and a haystack and context drift.
Google brag Gemini have two million token context window.
Monkey drop giant code repository inside Gemini.
Gemini say monkey, I see everything,
but when monkey asks specific bug location online for 100,
Gemini misneedle in haystack.
Large context window is not equal to high attention retrieval.
Gemini hallucinate wrong function name.
Claude have smaller context.
Ah, but Claude attention mechanism
retain precise long range logic.
Reason four is benchmark overfitting
versus real world execution.
Gemini win static human evil test on paper benchmark chart
because test questions are predictable,
but in messy real world production code base,
Gemini fail real jungle coding fight.
Will Gemini stay losing?
Google updating Gemini brain with deeper reasoning search tree.
But for now, if monkey want massive
multi file document summary, ask Gemini.
If monkey want working code without bug insect,
ask Claude, sometimes tech get really bananas.
Please subscribe for more monkey tech explainer.
